name: Kirisawa Takuto
source:
"Leave the fighting on the front line and giving out battlefield orders to me."

The leader of the SRX team that has great ability in giving out battle commands.
A serious perfectionist, he's very prideful and has absolute confidence in his own power, but he is a hard worker.
[url=/c29968]Yousuke[/url] is a good friend of his, but he also sees him as a rival.
He seems to worry about his small stature.
He plays main guitar and sings for the Odd-I's band.
His partner Substance is [url=/c30011]Lespaul[/url].
